composition_label: Product comparison -> Feedback analysis -> Guided setup

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch within the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict root keys: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, products, preferences, feedback, onboarding. Product attributes require price, weight, battery, each with value/unit. Preferences map metrics to positive weight and min/max direction. Feedback has id/product_id/text. Onboarding has steps and completed_steps; each step has id/title/prerequisites/when_themes.
shared_schema.handoffs: Every stage uses {schema_version:1, stage, data}; shared validate() checks both external input and stage outputs. Each consumer checks its predecessor and provenance against the original request.
shared_schema.output: {schema_version:1, synthetic:true, status:ok, result:guided-envelope}. Guided embeds validated feedback, which embeds validated comparison. Errors have schema_version, status:error, error and exit code 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Comparison normalizes attributes and ranks candidates. Its selected_product_id limits feedback analysis to the winner.
Feedback deduplicates winner reviews, emits themes with original excerpt IDs and all duplicate source IDs. Guided steps activate from these themes and carry traceable supporting excerpt IDs.
Guided setup transitively includes prerequisites even when their own theme conditions do not match; validates completed prerequisite chains.

behavior.comparison: Canonical units USD, g, hours; accepted units USD/cents, g/kg, hours/minutes. All three attributes required. Weighted min-max utility; equal-valued metrics give utility 1. Scores rounded to ten decimals, ties resolved by product ID.
behavior.feedback: Casefolded Unicode word-token sequence deduplication ignores punctuation and whitespace. Representative is lexicographically first review ID. Original text is preserved. Whole-word English themes battery/setup/value/portability; unmatched reviews use general. Counts are deduplicated review counts, not sentiment scores.
behavior.guided: Empty when_themes means unconditional; otherwise OR matching. Deterministic topological ordering with ID ties. States completed/available/blocked. Progress is completed/active steps, rounded to two decimals; no active steps means 100 percent.
behavior.errors: Rejects unknown keys, invalid units, missing attributes, nonfinite or negative values, boolean numbers, duplicate IDs/JSON keys, unknown references, cycles, impossible completion, and tampered handoffs.
behavior.persistence: Stateless CLI: progress is explicit in completed_steps; returned JSON is the persistent caller-owned result. No files are modified during CLI execution.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: exit 0, one valid JSON object, status ok, selected product aurora
